patterns.note: Full-width sections with content constrained to a central column, often featuring card-based grids for displaying information.
Prominent use of oversized, bold sans-serif headings in an accent color for hero text and section titles, creating strong visual hierarchy.
A consistent soft, light pink is used as the primary background color across the entire page, providing a distinctive and cohesive feel.
A sticky header navigation bar remains visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
A sticky cookie consent banner remains fixed at the bottom of the viewport, overlaying content until dismissed.
An accordion pattern is utilized for the 'Questions fréquentes' (FAQ) section, allowing users to expand and collapse answers.

technique_notes: A fixed header bar is positioned at the top of the viewport, maintaining visibility of the logo and primary navigation links during scroll.
A fixed cookie consent banner is positioned at the bottom of the viewport, appearing as an overlay until user interaction.

Content sections are structured with a maximum width and centered on the page, using a consistent light pink background for the overall page and white backgrounds for individual content cards or specific interactive elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, lighter body copy and uppercase navigation links.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are applied consistently to buttons, cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; the hero section features airy spacing, while content grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: The consistent use of a soft, light pink as the primary page background, combined with a vibrant coral accent for large, bold headings and calls to action, creates a distinctive friendly and playful aesthetic that stands out from typical corporate or minimalist designs. This color pairing gives the site a unique, approachable personality.
